_comment: Committee sizes. prepare_run.py applies the chosen size to the publication-type profile before the configuration: a reader, reviewer, editor list, limit or setting given explicitly in the configuration overrides the size. Readers are taken in the profile's order; lenses in the order of lensPriority (per type, else the default). See committee/config.md, field committeeSize.

low.description: Smallest committee: one reader, two lenses, the line editor, at most 2 rounds per unit, every role on Sonnet or below.

medium.description: Lean committee: one reader, three lenses, the line editor, at most 3 rounds per unit, every role on Opus or below except the Editor-in-Chief.

high.description: Most of the profile: two readers, five lenses, both editors, at most 4 rounds per unit, the default models.

full.description: The whole profile of the publication type: every reader, lens and editor, its limits and the default models.
